answer: Each identity must maintain a distinct 30-day storage trail: every day a beacon assigns a new 16 MB shard, and the node proves custody with a random byte range. Accounts that wander from one funding source share a quota; the kth alias receives k shards daily, so 100 fakes store 80.8 GB per day. An opal commitment binds each shard to its key and day. Missing two audits exposes the shale cluster and suspends all linked rewards for 20 epochs.
